records.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: individual fictional web-drama casting candidate photograph for '삭제된 11초'. Make ONE full-length vertical studio photograph of one original adult Korean character, not a collage. Head, body, hands and both feet fully visible with clear margin, centered upright relaxed stance facing camera, neutral camera at mid-torso, natural approximately seven-heads-tall adult proportions with balanced torso and legs. Plain pale warm-gray seamless background, soft neutral studio daylight, realistic skin and fabric detail, accurate hands, subtle professional casting-portrait polish. Attractive screen-actor presence. No text, labels, watermarks or extra people. Each candidate is a different fictional person whose facial proportions distinguish them; referenced actors are aesthetic inspiration, not an assertion about those actors or a scene depicting the real actors.
Character and fixed design: Han Seo-yun, 32-year-old Korean woman. User wants the beauty and atmosphere associated with Korean actresses Go Youn-jung (고윤정) and Kim Ji-won (김지원): strongly dimensional sculpted facial structure, luminous large expressive eyes, defined high nose bridge, refined full lips, elegant feminine charisma and a captivating slightly cosmopolitan look while clearly Korean. This should look like a striking leading actress, not a generic plain girl or a Caucasian woman. Long loose black hair with fine wispy bangs retained from the earlier user-selected hairstyle. Plain oatmeal cotton long-sleeved top and charcoal relaxed straight-leg trousers. Gray soft wrist brace exclusively on anatomical LEFT wrist (viewer RIGHT), right wrist bare, simple bare feet. No lace, jewelry, dress, outerwear or hospital bracelet. Calm natural gaze.
Specific distinct candidate: A: emphasize Go Youn-jung-inspired atmosphere, large rounded almond eyes, softer oval silhouette, delicately high nose, fuller natural lips, luminous youthful actress beauty while an adult 32-year-old character.
